title: UI Palooza — Compare AI web design models
excerpt: A test of taste. Compare AI-generated interfaces across models, design skills, and shared briefs. Explore real designs, runtime, tokens, and methodology.
content_html:
A test of taste.

Give different AI models the same brief. What do they choose for the type, the layout, the way an interface works?

UI Palooza puts those choices side by side. Compare models, add a design skill, or look across attempts to see what changes and what keeps showing up.

The story behind UI Palooza
